lines.speaker: Agent
lines.text: Hi, this is Dana with Crestline Financial. You'd asked about our aggressive growth portfolio.

lines.speaker: Customer
lines.text: Yes, I'm 68 and want to grow my retirement savings faster.

lines.speaker: Agent
lines.text: Honestly, an aggressive growth fund really isn't suitable for someone your age, I'd steer you toward something more conservative instead.

lines.speaker: Customer
lines.text: I appreciate the concern, but I've done my research and I'd like to proceed with the growth fund.

lines.speaker: Agent
lines.text: I hear you, let me pull up the paperwork for that.
